meta.notes: The district police post at night, for one man sneaking: every door that matters is locked on one key and the only ring is on the desk sergeant's belt; most men know the armoury pad's code, and the armoury has no other door; or a lock is picked in the corridor a man walks, or the breaker brings the ring out to the shed. A perimeter wall with a lit main gate, two side gates and the east gate into the impound (the way out), a main building of seven rooms off one corridor, a generator shed with the breaker, a guard hut, two pickups under a canopy, the radio mast on the back strip. Six beats authored, five manned a deal; two cameras, a keypad door. In the GWOT look kit. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts police-post
